d:
Start your day with calm and clarity with this 10-minute guided morning meditation for stress relief and relaxation.
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced meditator, this practice will help ground your energy and set a positive tone for the rest of your day.
In this session, you will experience:
• Guided breath awareness to quiet a busy mind
• Heart-centred mindfulness to release stress
• Gentle body grounding to start your morning refreshed
